summary: Router 0.42.10 closes the residual ADR-0131 left in TM-04: /api/ps (proxy.handle_ps, GET on the API app, behind client_auth_middleware like every inference path) answered every client with every loaded model, its role, the concrete model name and the node. Now (ADR-0133, proposed, extends ADR-0131) it uses auth.client_grant (no counting, no audit): a client that may use concrete names (models:true, the internal UI client, no identity in observe) gets every entry with model and node as before, but an entry whose role it may not use carries the concrete name instead of that role's name; a client without concrete names gets only entries of roles it may use, with name and model set to the role and no node, and nothing for models outside a role. The role mapping (tier models and same_blob) and sizes are unchanged; the Ollama shape (name, model, size, size_vram) stays. Access is unchanged: inference still goes through client_allows. No exception path added.

tests.evidence: 6 tests OK. New test_running_models_follow_the_grants with a node that has loaded a concrete model outside any role and models of two roles: models:true sees all three with model and node; a one-role client without models:true sees only its role by role name, no model, no node (rejected detail); all roles without models:true see both roles that way and no concrete model; models:true with one role sees the other role's model under its concrete name; observe without identity sees everything; no forbidden audit. With proxy.py from origin/main the new test fails.

tests.command: every python test/... and tools/... command of all workflows in .github/workflows/, except run_tests.py and check_public_changes (run separately); plus ruff check . and router.py --check router/config.example.yaml --pure

tests.evidence: run after staging this record; synthetic names only.

limitations: /api/show still answers details for any name a client asks about (model details, not node names), as before.
Per-client model allowlists (TM-04's other idea) are not added.
